title.zh: 电是怎么送进 CPU 的

desc.zh: 一颗 CPU 只用一伏左右的电压，却能吃下两三百瓦，也就是两百安上下的电流，负载还会在十来纳秒里猛跳上百安。电是怎么从墙上的插座一路送进芯片的？芯片为什么会自己降频？八个可以动手的模型：从插座到晶粒每一段丢掉多少电，功率怎么随电压和频率涨，电源在什么负载下最省，多相稳压怎么把纹波抵掉，负载一跳电压往下掉多少，跑完一件事用多快的频率最省电，空闲时睡多深，以及功率墙和散热器怎么一起决定频率。
desc.en: A CPU runs on about one volt, yet it can draw 200 to 300 watts, roughly 200 amps, and its load can jump by a hundred amps in about ten nanoseconds. How does power get from the wall socket into the chip, and why does the chip slow itself down? Eight hands-on models: how much each stage from the wall to the die loses, how power grows with voltage and frequency, at what load a power supply is most efficient, how a multiphase regulator cancels its ripple, how far the voltage sags when the load jumps, which clock finishes a job on the least energy, how deep to sleep when idle, and how power limits and the cooler together set the clock.

title.zh: 供电链：从插座到晶粒一路降压
title.en: The power-delivery chain: stepping down from the wall to the die

desc.zh: 220 伏交流 → 约 400 伏直流 → 12 伏 → 一伏左右；电压每降一级电流就涨一级，每一级都丢几个百分点变成热。
desc.en: 220 V AC → about 400 V DC → 12 V → about one volt; each step down raises the current and loses a few percent as heat.

zh: 电是怎么送进 CPU 的
en: how does power reach the CPU

title.zh: 动态功耗：功率随电压平方走
title.en: Dynamic power: power goes with voltage squared

desc.zh: 每次翻转都要给电容充放电，能量正比于 C·V²；频率越高电压越高，功率近似随频率三次方涨。
desc.en: Every switching event charges and discharges capacitance, energy proportional to C·V²; higher clocks need higher voltage, so power grows roughly with the cube of frequency.

zh: CPU 为什么电压这么低
en: why CPU voltage is so low

desc.zh: 电脑电源整流、做功率因数校正、隔着变压器降到 12 伏；在一半负载附近最省，很轻负载时效率掉得最多。
desc.en: A PC power supply rectifies, corrects the power factor and steps down to 12 V across a transformer; it is most efficient near half load and worst at very light load.

desc.zh: 主板上十几相降压电路轮流开关，把 12 伏降到一伏左右，各相的纹波互相抵掉；相数越多每相越凉。
desc.en: A dozen interleaved buck phases on the motherboard step 12 V down to about a volt; their ripple cancels and more phases run cooler.

desc.zh: 电流几纳秒内跳上百安，稳压器来不及反应，靠一层层电容顶住；负载线让电压随电流有意下斜，把落差预先算好。
desc.en: Current can jump by a hundred amps in nanoseconds; layers of capacitors hold the voltage until the regulator responds, and the load line lets voltage sag on purpose.

title.zh: 几百安怎么进到晶粒里
title.en: How hundreds of amps get into the die

desc.zh: 电流分给插座里的大量电源/地触点和封装下几千个凸点；电流过密会引起电迁移。片上稳压（FIVR）和电源门控在晶粒内部再分一次。
desc.en: Current is split across many power and ground contacts in the socket and thousands of bumps under the die; too much density causes electromigration. On-die regulators (FIVR) and power gating split it again.

desc.zh: 操作系统在 P-state 之间挑频率和电压；完成定量工作最省电的频率常在 V/f 曲线的拐点附近，不一定是最快。
desc.en: The OS picks P-states, frequency and voltage together; for a fixed job the most energy-efficient clock is usually near the knee of the V/f curve, not the fastest.

title.en: C-states: how deep to sleep when idle

desc.zh: 越深的 C-state 越省电但醒得越慢，还要睡够目标驻留时间才划算；空闲调速器每次都在猜这次会闲多久。
desc.en: Deeper C-states save more but wake slower and must last their target residency; the idle governor guesses each time how long the idle will last.

title.en: Power and thermal limits: PL1, PL2, Tau

desc.zh: CPU 降频一是功率墙（PL2 冲刺、PL1 管平均、Tau 是时间常数），二是温度墙（结温碰到 Tj max）；散热器只解决后者。
desc.en: A CPU throttles either at the power limit (PL2 burst, PL1 average, Tau time constant) or at the thermal limit (junction temperature at Tj max); a better cooler only helps the second.

title.zh: 数据中心供电：48 伏与 800 伏直流
title.en: Data-center power: 48 V and 800 V DC

desc.zh: 一颗加速器一千瓦、一个机架上百千瓦：机架电压从 12 伏升到 48 伏，再走向 800 伏直流，因为同功率下线损随电压平方下降。
desc.en: Accelerators draw a kilowatt each and racks over a hundred: rack power moves from 12 V to 48 V and toward 800 V DC, because line loss falls with the square of voltage.

title.zh: 供电前沿（2026 年 11 月）

desc.zh: 背面供电（PowerVia、Super Power Rail）、贴在芯片下的垂直供电模块、800 伏直流机架：哪些已经量产，哪些还在演示。
desc.en: Backside power (PowerVia, Super Power Rail), vertical power modules under the chip, 800 V DC racks: what ships and what is still a demo.

title.zh: 电脑降频时先查哪一段
title.en: Which stage limits first when a PC throttles

desc.zh: 电源、稳压模块、电容、触点、热阻、功率墙各有上限；跑不满时先找哪一段先到顶。
desc.en: PSU, VRM, capacitors, contacts, thermal resistance and power limits each have a ceiling; when a machine falls short, find which one hits first.
